name: Sol
storyline:
It is night when it should be daytime. The cold and darkness flood the snowy streets of the city in the middle of June; but the alarm clock continues to sound every day at 8:00. Pablo still runs curricula, writes his end-of-degree work and takes advantage of when he can to make some beer with his friends.

He has always been afraid of changes: Finishing university, finding a future full of uncertainties... And an apocalypse doesn't help.

A newly graduated from university student who will have to find his place in a changing and increasingly less welcoming world.

It is up to him to look for work, to continue paying rent, to reconnect with old friends...

Will he be able to meet all his expectations in the midst of a global crisis? He will come to see that future he longed for so much... Or is it true that the world ends?
summary: The sun has been gone for months, but the alarm clock continues to ring every day at 8:00. A visual novel in Catalan.
